description: Embedded Figures is a crucial topic in Non-verbal Logical Reasoning. It involves finding a small target figure hidden or embedded within a complex diagram. This tests the candidate's visual perception.

sections.title: Basic Concept
sections.description: Understanding the structure of figures and their concealment is essential in this topic.

key_concepts.explanation: The small and simple figure that is completely merged or hidden inside a large and complex figure.
The network of lines and geometric shapes inside which the target figure is hidden without changing its form.

sections.title: Important Rules
sections.description: Key points to keep in mind while solving embedded figure questions accurately.

results: Generally, rotating the target figure is not allowed. It must be found in the exact same orientation.
Only check options with rotation if the figure is not found in the direct orientation.
The proportion of the hidden figure and the relative length of the lines should match the target figure.
The overall size might vary slightly, but the basic geometric shape must remain identical.

sections.title: Steps to Solve Questions
sections.description: A systematic approach to quickly and accurately finding the hidden figure in complex diagrams.

steps.title: Analyze the Target
steps.detail: Carefully observe the main angles, junctions, and specific turns of the given small target figure.

steps.title: Elimination Method
steps.detail: Eliminate options where the major lines or specific angles of the target figure are clearly missing.

steps.title: Tracing the Lines
steps.detail: Mentally trace the outline of the target figure in the most probable option and confirm that all parts align perfectly.

sections.title: Common Types of Questions
sections.description: The standard formats of questions primarily asked in competitive exams.

results: A small target figure is provided as the question.
You must select the option among four complex figures in which the target figure is perfectly embedded.
A large and complex figure is provided as the question.
You must select the one option among four small figures that is clearly hidden within the large picture.
